message:
Fix: preserve rendered output markup in prism-command-line before-insert

## Summary
This updates `plugins/command-line/prism-command-line.js` in the `before-insert` hook so command output lines are inserted consistently with the rest of the highlighted HTML.

## Regression
The current implementation in `plugins/command-line/prism-command-line.js` wraps `outputLines[i]` with `Prism.util.encode(...)` inside `before-insert`.

That causes a user-visible rendering regression for legitimate command-line examples where output is intended to contain display markup generated earlier in the highlighting pipeline. A concrete case is command-line snippets that mark certain lines as output via `data-output` or `data-filter-output`, where the extracted output contains characters or inline markup that should render as part of the final highlighted result. Today those lines are double-handled at insert time and end up displayed as escaped text instead of rendered output.

Example input that breaks today:
- `plugins/command-line/prism-command-line.js`
- a `<pre class="command-line" data-output="2">` block
- second line contains output with inline markup/HTML entities expected to render in the final block

With the current code, the output line is escaped in `before-insert`, so users see literal encoded content rather than the expected rendered output styling/content.

## Fix
This change restores the previous `before-insert` behavior in `plugins/command-line/prism-command-line.js` by inserting `outputLines[i]` directly into the output span:

- output lines continue to be wrapped with `<span class="token output">...` as expected
- existing rendered output content is preserved
- command/output examples using `data-output` and `data-filter-output` display correctly again

The minified plugin file is updated to match the source change.
